name: Cloak of Weakness
body:
Price 1,000 gp (–1), 4,000 gp (–2), 9,000 gp (–3), 16,000 gp (–4), 25,000 gp (–5); Aura faint conjuration; CL 5th; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This cursed item appears to be a cloak of resistance, but has the opposite function. Instead of granting a resistance bonus to all saving throws, the cloak grants a –1 to –5 penalty to all saving throws.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 500 gp (-1), 2,000 Gp (-2), 4,500 gp (-3), 8,000 gp (-4), 12,500 gp (-5); Feats Craft Cursed Item; Spells bestow curse; Special creator’s caster level must be three times the cloak’s penalty
